name: Image Optimizer by wps.sk
author: WPS.sk

sections.description:
Image Optimizer from wps.sk is here to make it easier for you to work with images.

Image optimization will ensure images that take up much less space. Optimized images help your website load faster, which will help you with speed measurements, but also for the user experience.

After activating and configuring the plugin, it will automatically optimize images when uploaded and also convert them to the modern webp format.

Options in settings

  • Keep original image (choose from options)
  • Image quality in the range of 0-100 (enter a value)
  • Compression method in the range of 0-6 (enter a value)
  • Allowed image types (choose from options)
  • Copy file name to alternative text (choose from options)
  • Maximum image width (enter a value)
